Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: SERVICE=redwood-inference-api ENV=prod-eu metric=latency.p99 value=1850ms threshold=500ms
PagerDuty: page triggered -> team=eng-oncall, urgency=high, incident=INC-2026-742
Mike H: acked the page (I got this) :hand:
Anjali R: joining — any initial scope? full region or subset?
Mike H: seeing p95 ~ 350ms, p99 ~ 1850ms for /v1/generate in eu-west; backend model variant v2-quant showing CPU/GPU skew, 15% error increase on short requests
Sam T: logs show a spike of KV cache evictions around 2026-03-15T07:12Z, lot of cache-miss latencies piling into hot path
Irene L: checking autoscaler metrics now — avg GPU utilization 95% on inference-prod-eu pool, queue depth up ~3x normal
SRE Lead: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/latency-slo-burn — follow triage -> reduce batching -> enable fallthrough routing -> scale pool
Mike H: running quick mitigations: 1) reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 16 on route /v1/generate 2) enable model-fallback to v2-fp16-copy 3) trigger scale pool +2 GPUs
Mike H: command: ```redwood infra scale-pool --name inference-prod-eu --delta 2 --reason "p99 SLO burn"```
Ops Shift: autoscaler override submitted, request accepted, starting new instances (eta ~3m)
Anjali R: enabled fallback routing to v2-fp16-copy for region eu-west (non-blocking). Will monitor for quality regressions.
Sam T: reduced batch size applied via route config, seeing immediate drop in per-request queueing for small requests
Irene L: snapshot of metrics after changes (07:16Z): p95=220ms p99=720ms error_rate=1.4% (was 3.2%)
SRE Lead: good progress. still above p99 SLO but trending down. Any customer-visible errors?
Mike H: Customer telemetry: a subset of high-throughput customers saw degraded tail latency and a few 504s between 07:11-07:14Z. No broad outage. I've opened ticket RED-6758 with customer-impact tag.
Anjali R: quick check on KV cache thrash — looks like an unbounded prefix-heavy workload from a single client. I've flagged their API key (temp rate limit) and asked Product for contact.
PagerDuty: escalation policy applied -> paging escalation to SRE Lead if not acknowledged in 5m
Sam T: posting relevant logs:
```
2026-03-15T07:12:03Z inference-prod-eu sidecar[pid=4123]: KVCache::evict key=ctx:abc123 size=120MB reason=memory_pressure
2026-03-15T07:12:04Z model-server[pid=8123]: request queue wait=420ms batch_size=64 model=v2-quant
2026-03-15T07:12:05Z model-server[pid=8123]: token_latency p99=1850ms p95=350ms
```
Irene L: also seeing GPU mem throttle warnings on node g4-eu-12 at same timeframe
Mike H: continuing steps: 1) keep fallback active, 2) maintain reduced batch size until pool scales, 3) watch for quality alerts from Optimize (eval diffs)
Anjali R: started temporary rate-limit rule for offending API key: limit=60rps burst=100 (applied)
SRE Lead: eta for new GPUs was 3m, now provisioning complete. Ops Shift reports nodes healthy and joined cluster at 07:20Z
Irene L: post-scale metrics (07:22Z): p95=190ms p99=420ms error_rate=0.7% queue_depth back to baseline
Mike H: rolling back batch size to 32 cautiously to test throughput recovery
Anjali R: monitoring quality alerts, no regressions flagged for top-100 evals so far
SRE Lead: marking incident as mitigated but keeping thread open for root-cause. Prepare post-incident note: cause = KV cache thrash from single high-throughput client causing eviction storms -> increased queuing -> p99 spike. Action items: 1) persistent rate-limit for offending key, 2) autoscaler tuning for faster scale-up on burst, 3) add KV eviction metrics to runbook triggers.
Mike H: acknowledged. I'll own customer comms and link ticket RED-6758.
Irene L: adding dashboard charts to incident board and scheduling a brief postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC
Sam T: one more: add early warning alert when KV eviction rate > 50/min for 2m.
SRE Lead: good. If no other issues, handoff to day SRE in 30m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Ops Shift: handoff note posted to #oncall-handoffs, next oncall = Anjali R at 08:00Z
Mike H: closing pager and leaving this thread for follow-up notes and postmortem drafts
Incident Bot: incident INC-2026-742 status=mitigated responders=[Mike H, Anjali R, Sam T, Irene L]
